title: Highlights Captured per Book
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=highlight:capture
| stats count as highlights by book
| eventstats avg(highlights) as avg_h
| sort - highlights
description: Counts the passages you highlighted in each book, a proxy for which ones truly resonated with you.
value: A highlight count surfaces the books worth revisiting and feeds a spaced-review habit that makes reading stick.
implementation: Ingest highlights into `index=personal`; count per book.
visualization: Bar chart of highlights captured per book.
grandmaExplanation: It counts the passages you highlighted in each book, showing which ones really spoke to you.
